zh: 判断条件“列表中恰好有一个元素等于 2x”只依赖于 2x 这个值在整个列表中的出现次数，和 x 的位置无关。
先统计每个值的出现次数（值域只有 0..1000，2x 最多 2000，可以直接开数组）。然后对输入中的每个元素 x（包括重复出现的）检查 freq[2x] 是否恰为 1。
满足条件的 x 全部放进结果（重复的 x 各算一次），排序后用空格连接输出；结果为空时输出空行。注意 0 的两倍还是 0，所以 0 只有在列表里恰好出现一次时才会被选中。时间 O(n log n)。
en: The condition "exactly one element equals 2x" depends only on how many times the value 2x occurs in the whole list, not on where x is.

First count how many times each value occurs (values are 0..1000 and 2x is at most 2000, so a plain array works). Then for every element x of the input, repeats included, check whether freq[2x] is exactly 1.

Put every qualifying x into the result (each repeated x counts separately), sort it and print it space-separated; print an empty line if the result is empty. Note that twice 0 is still 0, so 0 is selected only if it occurs exactly once in the list. Time O(n log n).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the frequency of each value. For each element x of the input, check whether freq[2x] is exactly 1; if so, add it to the answer, and sort at the end.

## Correctness

The frequency array reflects exactly how many times each integer appears in the list. Checking the condition at every input position keeps all repeated x; the requirement of exactly one 2x is expressed precisely by a frequency equal to 1. Sorting satisfies the output order.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(1001+n).
